main.description: Resolves one collection's embedded items in source order, one level only. Each target must match the item's exact strong-reference URI+CID; nested collections are summaries, and unavailable versions or unsupported kinds return record null. Pagination follows the latest indexed collection at the same URI across pages, even after collection changes; no version-change error or restart is required. Item additions, removals, or reordering may cause skipped or repeated results. There is no sortDirection parameter. Authentication is not required.

collection.description: Full collection record AT-URI using a DID authority.

limit.description: Maximum embedded items in the page; default 25.

cursor.description: Opaque item-pagination cursor. Continue with the same collection URI; it is not bound to a collection version.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The collection AT-URI, page bound, cursor, or query parameters are invalid.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No indexed collection exists at this AT-URI.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when there is no next page.

collectionSummaryView.description: Non-recursive summary of a collection item target.

featureView.description: Feature record view with hydrated author actor; feature location, tag, and sameAs references remain unexpanded.

collectionItemView.description: One embedded collection item in source order, retaining its original strong reference and optional weight. Resolve only an exact URI+CID target one level deep; nested collections use a summary, and unavailable versions or unsupported kinds produce record null.

record.description: Resolved ActivityView, CollectionSummaryView, or FeatureView using the item strong reference's exact URI+CID; otherwise null.
